ValidationRule.description: Error on create endorsement for 107 and 190 IF there is an open application
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: IF( AND( NOT( ISNULL(Account__r.Recent_Application_Lookup__c)), Account__r.Recent_Application_Lookup__r.Is_Lost__c == false , OR( Endorsement_Number__c == 'IL 107', Endorsement_Number__c == 'IL 190')) , true, false)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Cannot create endorsement due to pending application.
